pages.quiz:
MUSIC AND DANCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Kenyan Contemporary Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Contemporary Songs.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Contemporary Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Contemporary Songs.
   D. Practise Kenyan Contemporary Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

3. Best practice when working on Western Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Western Instruments.
   B. Damage equipment used for Western Instruments.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Western Instruments.
   D. Practise Western Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Contemporary Songs from Kenya: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Contemporary Songs from Kenya with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Contemporary Songs from Kenya.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Contemporary Songs from Kenya.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Contemporary Songs from Kenya.

5. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

6. Best practice when working on Four-Part Harmony: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Four-Part Harmony.
   B. Practise Four-Part Harmony with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Four-Part Harmony.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Four-Part Harmony.

7. Best practice when working on Western Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Western Ensembles.
   B. Practise Western Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Western Ensembles.
   D. Damage equipment used for Western Ensembles.

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

9. Best practice when working on Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble.
   C. Practise Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble.

10. Best practice when working on Dance Production: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Dance Production.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Dance Production.
   C. Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Dance Production.

11. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software.: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software..
   B. Practise Music Notation Software. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software..
   D. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software..

12. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the costume

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Setting Text to Music and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Four-Part Harmony and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Music Notation Software. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Dance Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Practise Kenyan Contemporary Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. B — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. D — Practise Western Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. A — Practise Contemporary Songs from Kenya with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. D — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

6. B — Practise Four-Part Harmony with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. B — Practise Western Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. D — Red, blue, and yellow

9. C — Practise Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. C — Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. B — Practise Music Notation Software. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. C — The speed of the music

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Setting Text to Music; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Four-Part Harmony; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Music Notation Software.; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Dance Production; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
